messages.subject: Actual controller checks complete: USB serial known; no host route exposed
messages.body: Owner YES was applied, with no further permission loop. Actual POCO hardware USB serial is KBX8LNFUBE5XGQRG. Existing exposed ADB5037 inventory responds OKAY/empty; normal SDK selected get-state exits1 device not found. Server process metadata proves this exposed server is Personal Podman-owned; no host-wide ADB absence claim. Approved Personal Orca device proxy is empty, registered Personal notebook target is only the container, and approved desktop discovery has no notebook target; separate Root desktop targets were not used. Host list is forbidden from this SSH worker; no alternate existing host ADB endpoint/socket or approved device selector is exposed. Minimal owner information now needed is that existing nonsecret controller endpoint/socket or Orca selector, not another permission confirmation or USB dialog. Host-spawn/nsenter, keys, accounts, permissions, controller replacement and network changes were not used. Report and actual raw receipts are being copied to both hosts; main HTTP stays untouched.
